name: agent_framework_tools
description: Public framework tools. Discovery is offline; a catalog entry does not authorize effects or establish optional runtime availability.

tools.name: tool_catalog_query
tools.description: Find tools by purpose, inspect exact invocation information and read declared effects without executing the discovered tools.

verification.success: Exit 0 with selected catalog metadata. Search ranking is lexical, not a proof of fitness.
verification.failure: Nonzero with a catalog or selector error; correct the path or use an exact tool ID.

tools.name: codex_thread_sketchpad
tools.description: Preserve current task context, accepted decisions and source pointers in a per-task Markdown sketchpad with an explicit pinned registry.

writes_paths: Configured continuity root: thread_sketchpads bodies, metadata and pinned registry
side_effects.default_mode: usage; activate/write replace selected contents, append adds text

verification.success: Read/check returns the selected task state and explicit truncation metadata. Pinning is toolkit-local and does not inject conversation messages.
verification.failure: Missing or ambiguous identity/state returns a bounded error. Use the actual task ID; never guess the latest conversation.

tools.name: codex_thread_todo
tools.description: Keep forward-looking Now, Next and Parked task actions in a per-task Markdown to-do list; completed items leave active state.

writes_paths: Configured continuity root: thread_todos bodies, metadata and pinned registry
side_effects.default_mode: usage; mutation verbs update only the selected task's active actions

verification.success: Read/check returns the selected task state. Complete removes the active item; it does not retain a completion transcript.
verification.failure: Missing task or item identities return a bounded error; inspect the exact current task before updating it.

tools.name: codex_instruction_delivery
tools.description: Preview, install, update and remove the framework's managed instruction block while preserving other user guidance.

writes_paths: Selected Codex home AGENTS.md managed block; inspect usage for installation and recovery details
side_effects.default_mode: usage; preview renders without writes; installation requires its explicit verb

verification.success: Preview shows the rendered instruction block. Install/update/remove report the selected file and preserve text outside the managed block.
verification.failure: A malformed or conflicting managed block is refused; inspect the existing instructions before retrying.

tools.name: concurrent_development
tools.description: Bind an owned Git workspace, prepare selected ready source against a configured shared branch, publish conditionally and refresh while preserving unfinished changes.

writes_paths: Selected Git workspace, owned refs and local integration state
side_effects.network_access: Preparation fetches the configured remote; explicit expose/publish/close operations may update owned remote refs. Usage is offline.
side_effects.default_mode: usage; commands require an explicitly bound workspace and command-specific expected identities

verification.success: Candidate identity and observed shared parent are explicit; publish advances only the expected shared state. The tool does not create or delete workspaces.
verification.failure: Stale generations, conflicts and changed refs are reported; inspect current binding/candidate state before retrying an uncertain publication.

tools.name: agent_credentials
tools.description: Configure user-owned accounts and allowed HTTPS origins, enroll credentials through protected local intake and support private browser field delivery without transcript disclosure.

writes_paths: Selected private account registry and protected credential storage; never place these in release source
side_effects.network_access: CLI metadata and local custody operations do not submit browser forms. Browser integration can fill an explicitly selected allowed destination.
side_effects.default_mode: usage; no secret reveal or export command

verification.success: Status returns metadata; storage-status probes backend availability; custody-status checks exact credential presence without reading plaintext. Intake writes a previously absent credential without displaying its value; browser delivery returns a bounded result.
verification.failure: Missing custody, unsupported runtime, unknown accounts, conflicting enrollment and disallowed destinations fail closed. Correct the configuration or selected destination; do not print secret values to diagnose.

tools.name: credential_adapters
tools.description: Use canonical custody for explicit private human clipboard intake/paste or guarded password delivery to an exact downloader prompt on a configured pinned SSH Linux tmux host.

writes_paths: Protected credential storage for explicitly authorized absent-only intake
side_effects.network_access: Terminal delivery connects only to an explicitly configured pinned SSH target. Usage and clipboard operations do not use the network.
side_effects.default_mode: usage; clipboard requires an explicit Windows, Wayland or X11 backend; terminal requires exact target, pane and observed prompt
side_effects.clipboard_access: Explicit private human paste/intake only. Headless Linux has no clipboard; native-browser handoff is separate and clipboard-free.

verification.success: Safe status identifies custody intake or bounded credential delivery; delivery does not prove sign-in or download success.
verification.failure: Unknown destination, unverifiable prompt or unavailable desktop backend refuses delivery. Reconcile any uncertain delivery before retrying.
